meta.dataset: UNGC — Updated Nearby Galaxy Catalog (Local Volume)
meta.coordinateFrame: ICRS equatorial (J2000); ra/dec in decimal degrees

distanceKindLegend.trgb_cepheid: Tip of the RGB or Cepheid period-luminosity — the best rungs of the distance ladder.
distanceKindLegend.luminosity_distance: Photometric / standard-candle luminosity distance from a secondary indicator.
distanceKindLegend.geometric: Geometric (maser or detached eclipsing binary) — no ladder assumed.
distanceKindLegend.inherited: Adopted from the distance of the host group, not measured for this galaxy.
distanceKindLegend.redshift_space: Derived from recession velocity via a Hubble flow model. NOT a measured distance.

meta.note: The published VizieR table J/AJ/145/101/catalog holds 869 galaxies, not the ~1400 now listed by the live Local Volume database (www.sao.ru/lv/lvgdb). This file is the frozen, citable 2013 catalogue. cartesian position = ra/dec/distMpc; no cosmology applied.
